full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff contended that the suit land comprising an area of 51 acres of plot No. 1048 appertaining to S.A. Khatian No. 74 of mouza Chagarghona, P.S. Manikganj, District Dhaka belonged to Jaladhar Gope and Adhari Gope. Jaladhar died leaving sons Jagadish, Sidam and Balaram and Balaram died leaving 2 sons Sunil and Santosh. Adhari died leaving 2 daughters Basana and Haridasi. Then Basana died leaving sister Haridasi. While Jagadish, Sidam, Sunil, Santosh and Haridasi were possessing the suit land on payment of rent, they exchanged the suit land and other lands with the Indian lands of the plaintiff's elder brother P.W. 2 Sawkat Ali in 1963. Sawkat Ali executed and registered a deed of exchange in favour of Jagadish and, others. Jagadish and others in their turn executed a power of attorney in favour of the plaintiff. On the basis of the said power of attorney the plaintiff executed and registered the deed of exchange in respect of the suit lands and other lands in favour of his elder brother P.W. 2 Sawkat Ali on 14th Chaitra, 1369 B.S. corresponding to 28.3.63. P.W. 2 Sawkat Ali used to hold the suit land sometimes by giving barga to the defendant No. 1 Abed Ali and his cousin Mia Chand alias Abdur Rahman and Lehajuddin and sometimes by his own cultivation. Later he sold away 31 acres out of the suit land along with other lands by a registered deed dated 24th Chaitra, 1370 B.S. corresponding to 7.4.64 (Ext. 2(b) in favour of Tozammel Hossain, who after possessing the same by bargaders and by self sold away the same to the plaintiff Arshed Ali by a registered deed of sale dated 8th Bhadra, 1376 B.S. corresponding to 25.8.69 Ext. 2(c). P.W. 2 Sawkat Ali sold away the remaining 20 acres of the suit land by a registered deed of sale dated 16th Agrahayan, 1375 B.S. corresponding to 2.12.68 to plaintiff (Ext. 2(b). Thus the plaintiff became the 16 annas owner of the suit plot. While the plaintiff possessed the suit land, the defendants after manufacturing forged and fraudulent deed entered into the suit land in the last part of Aswin 1376 B.S. and dispossessed the plaintiff by cutting down 10/12 mango trees and by erecting 4 straw huts. Again in the last part of Magh, 1387 B.S. the defendants have erected a tin hut within the suit land. As such the plaintiff was forced to file the suit on 17.6.75.
